verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents 'Intuit Intelligence' AI chat that answers questions like 'What's driving my profit?' and 'How are my invoices doing?', generates reports on expenses/sales trends/benchmarking, and Payroll AI that spots inconsistencies—directly matching the story of AI-generated insights from data. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the insight quality and no third-party reviews confirming these AI features work as described in practice.
